name: 46714 · Bluffton, IN
findings: ZIP 46714 (Bluffton) has 81 nonprofit organizations. 32 of them (40%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is public events, listed by 24 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (33% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 46714 (Bluffton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
44% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: More organizations list public events
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 46714 (Bluffton) list public events on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 2.2 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 24 organizations here; 54% of all organizations here have no identified type.
